configurations.// crosstabs-docker: Full app, including Playwright's Chromium, so a real crosstab run works end to end. Use this one when testing the actual pipeline. Code is baked into the image -- rebuild (docker build -t ghcr.io/itayole/crosstabs-portal:latest .) to pick up edits.
configurations.name: crosstabs-docker

configurations.// crosstabs-dev: Flask dev server with auto-reload, for UI/template/CSS work -- edits apply immediately, no rebuild. Serves the page and accepts the auth_state.json upload, but cannot complete a run: the venv has the playwright package without its Chromium binary. Install it with .venv/Scripts/python -m playwright install chromium if you need real runs here.
configurations.name: crosstabs-dev
